annotation.bound_parties_text: The guidance is aimed at all stakeholders involved with AI in the energy sector, including licensees, market participants, operators of essential services, dutyholders, technology companies and AI developers, though it sets out good practice rather than binding rules.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This guidance is therefore aimed at all stakeholders involved with AI in the sector which includes, but is not limited to, licensees, market participants, operators of essential services, dutyholders, technology companies, AI developers, consumer groups, other regulators and government.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Ethical AI use in the energy sector (version 2)
